description: trail-blazer-flow: PreToolUse guard that approves only the exact git -C <worktree> <subcommand> forms worktree-parallel mode issues (see issue #150); says nothing about everything else, so the normal permission flow — a prompt, or a matching deny rule, which always wins over this hook's decision — applies. The handler's if gate (#155, Claude Code 2.1.85+) restricts when this hook is even spawned to git -C Bash calls; it can only reduce spawns, never widen approval — the guard script remains the backstop for everything else.
